headline: Align Technology (ALGN) Reports Record Q2 Revenue, Is The Stock Still Below Fair Value?
summary: What the latest guidance and Q2 results tell you about Align Technology Align Technology (ALGN) just paired record second quarter revenue with updated 2026 guidance, giving you fresh data on how its clear aligner business, margins, and cash returns to shareholders are evolving. The company reported second quarter 2026 sales of US$1.06b, with clear aligner volumes supporting that performance while systems and services saw softer demand.
